title: Sanofi-Aventis Australia Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of Ostelin brands from Reckitt Benckiser Australia Pty Ltd
targets: Ostelin brands from Reckitt Benckiser Australia Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Sanofi-Aventis Australia Pty Ltd proposed to acquire Ostelin brands from Reckitt Benckiser Australia Pty Ltd.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the competitive effects of the proposed acquisition in the context of: - the national market for the wholesale supply of calcium supplements; and - the national market for the wholesale supply of vitamin D supplements. However, the ACCC recognised that the results of the analysis would have been unchanged, regardless of the market definition adopted.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC formed the view that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets. Factors informing this conclusion included: - the merged entity would continue to be constrained by existing and potential competitors; - barriers to entry and expansion are low; and - the relevant markets are dynamic.
